test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 03 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Exemplary
solution: The correct answer is **unsatisfactory.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Exemplary:** very good; that can be an example to other people. (श्रेष्‍ठ, बहुत अच्‍छा; औरों के लिए आदर्श) • **Unsatisfactory: **not acceptable; not good enough. (संतोषजनक नहीं; पर्याप्त नहीं) • Thus, the most appropriate antonym of the given word is **option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Flattering: **making somebody look or sound more attractive or important than he/she really is. ((किसी को) वास्‍तविकता से अधिक आकर्षक या महत्वपूर्ण दर्शाते हुए) • **Imitative: **copying or following a model or example. (नक़ली) • **Desirable:** wanted, often by many people; worth having. (वांछनीय; अपेक्षित) 1b8:T74e, The correct answer is **beguilling**.
